description: This file is a shell script used to generate size class definitions for jemalloc, a memory allocator. It computes various size class parameters based on platform-specific configurations and outputs C header code with macros defining size class tables and limits.

methods.name: pow2
methods.description: Calculates 2^e and stores the result in a global variable.

methods.name: lg
methods.description: Computes the base-2 logarithm of a number.

methods.name: lg_ceil
methods.description: Calculates the ceiling of log2 for a given number.

methods.name: reg_size_compute
methods.description: Computes register size based on group and delta parameters.

methods.name: slab_size
methods.description: Calculates the smallest slab size that is an integer multiple of register size.

methods.name: size_class
methods.description: Generates size class parameters and outputs configuration macros.

methods.name: sep_line
methods.description: Outputs a separator line in the generated code.

methods.name: size_classes
methods.description: Main function that iterates over configurations to generate size class definitions.
